_note: Daily energy score (0-100), computed fresh every dashboard render from last night's sleep + today's nutrition/caffeine/alcohol/movement — a same-day metric, unlike the sperm score's rolling 7-day window. Sources for the model: sleep 7-9h band, blood-sugar-stable nutrition, regular movement, caffeine <=~400mg (~5 shots) with a cutoff before bed, and alcohol's next-day sleep-quality hit (see generate_dashboard.py compute_energy_score for citations discussed with the user).
